title: Leading layout across aspect ratios
slide_intent: Keep the starting point of a composition consistent so viewers can orient themselves across changing formats.
strategic_value: A leading 4 and adjacent action text can connect Channel 4 portrait and landscape promotions.
demonstration: Outlined portrait, square and wide frames change around a top-left green 4 with small action copy to its right.
practical_value: Check whether the identity and action retain their relationship when the canvas changes shape.

content_islands.name: Format boundary
content_islands.spec: Animate the thin outline between portrait, square and landscape formats.

content_islands.name: Leading pair
content_islands.spec: Keep the mark near the upper-left corner and action text immediately to its right.

reference_purposes.Application: The animation compares the leading identity and text across aspect ratios.
reference_purposes.Intent: Pentagram says consistent layout hierarchy keeps 4 in a leading position across outputs.

ingredient.name: Leading identity and action
ingredient.application: Retain the upper-left mark and adjacent action relationship across the demonstrated formats.
ingredient.scope: Observed format examples in the 2023 case study; no fixed pixel offsets are stated.
